name: dooles-tools
description: doolecg's Claude Code mods: Main Menu, Flightdeck, Bottom Bar, Task View, Self Improve, Prompt Enhancer, Idea Shelf, Context, Rule Guard and Mod Settings. The skills are in doolecg/Dooles_Skills.

plugins.name: bottom-bar
plugins.description: A compact rounded bar in the terminal and above the prompt in the desktop app (model, effort, context, 5-hour and 7-day usage, agents, and the to-do bar) with a Tools button that opens the Main Menu.

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: Task View: Claude's to-do list drawn with pixel progress bars, green and still when every step is done.

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: The main session and every subagent working now, each with a pixel progress bar, what it is doing and a stop button, in the Bottom Bar's colours.

plugins.name: sidebar
plugins.description: Main Menu (called Sidebar before): one top-level menu with a tab for each installed mod, switched-off mods dimmed and Mod Settings always last, in the Bottom Bar's colours.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: An Enhance Prompt button in the Bottom Bar (or its own row) that rewrites the prompt in the box using Hindsight, CodeGraph, the session, your soul.md and your skills, with recall counts and Undo.

plugins.name: self-improve
plugins.description: Learns from finished sessions: lessons to Hindsight or markdown, a soul.md profile kept in step with a Soul Bank, skill drafts and fixes you approve, a skill scorecard and rollback.

plugins.name: idea-shelf
plugins.description: Park ideas with /idea while Claude works, one shelf per project, and send them later from /ideas.

plugins.name: context
plugins.description: Publishes the facts for the Main Menu footer (Hindsight, CodeGraph, git, test and fix passes) and counts test and fix passes against a limit.

plugins.name: rule-guard
plugins.description: Stops tool calls that break your rules (AI credit in commits, v tags, pushing or releasing unasked, killing by name, skipping hooks, testing past the pass limit) and tells Claude why. Each rule is a switch in Mod Settings.

plugins.name: mod-settings
plugins.description: Every installed mod's settings in one side panel in the desktop app, changed in place. Open it with /doole_settings.

plugins.name: chat-bubbles
plugins.description: Claude's replies in soft bubbles, your messages under the folder with a corner line, tool calls and code changes folded to one line, and the folder line under each reply.
